quote: Imagine you wake up / with a second chance: The blue jay / hawks his pretty wares / and the oak still stands, spreading / glorious shade. If you don’t look back, / the future never happens.
source: Rita Dove, Dawn Revisited, lines 1 to 6, On the Bus with Rosa Parks (W. W. Norton, 1999)
